customers.evidence: Our mission is to deliver great value to our customers every day.

shareholders.evidence: Historically, our strong financial returns and cash generation allowed us to simultaneously invest in the growth of the business and return cash to shareholders.

result.analyst_notes: Factual and aspirational in tone, with the mission statement leading and centred on customer value. Customers are addressed first and most often, with shareholder returns secondary. Written in the third-person corporate 'we' voice with confident, absolute claims such as 'we believe'. Workforce, environment, and integrity are essentially absent; the page is mostly business description.
